original:
Let $k\geq 1$ be odd, let $F=\mathbb{F}_{3^{k}}$ , and put

 $T=\{(x,x^{2},x^{4}):x\in F\}\subset F^{3}.$ 

Every six-term zero-sum sequence supported on $T$ consists either of one
element taken six times or of two distinct elements taken three times each.
Consequently, since $F^{3}\cong C_{3}^{3k}$ as groups,

 $A_{6}(C_{3}^{3k})\ \geq\ 2\cdot 3^{k}.$
